record.paper_title: Topological Open Problems in the Geometry of Banach Spaces
record.context_brief: Radon-Nikodym property and Kadec or rotund renorming
record.original_question: Let X be a Banach space with the Radon-Nikodym property, meaning every bounded closed convex subset of X has slices of arbitrarily small diameter. Must X admit an equivalent Kadec norm? Must X admit an equivalent rotund, equivalently strictly convex, norm?

evidence.quote: Question 5. If the Banach space X has the Radon Nikodym property (i.e., every bounded closed convex subset of X has slices of arbitrarily small diameter), does it follow that X has an equivalent Kadec norm? Does it have an equivalent rotund norm?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A Banach space $X$ is said to have the Radon–Nikodým property (RNP) if every bounded closed convex subset of $X$ admits slices of arbitrarily small diameter (where a slice of a bounded convex set $C$ is a nonempty intersection of $C$ with an open half-space).

An equivalent norm $|\!|\!|\cdot|\!|\!|$ on $X$ is called:
- a Kadec norm if on the unit sphere $\{x\in X:|\!|\!|x|\!|\!|=1\}$ the weak topology and the norm topology coincide;
- rotund (equivalently, strictly convex) if whenever $|\!|\!|x|\!|\!|=|\!|\!|y|\!|\!|=1$ and $x\neq y$, then $|\!|\!|(x+y)/2|\!|\!|<1$.

Question: Must every Banach space $X$ with the Radon–Nikodým property admit an equivalent Kadec norm? Must every such $X$ admit an equivalent rotund norm?
artifact.status_search_result: The question of whether every Banach space with the Radon–Nikodým property admits an equivalent rotund (and equivalently a Kadec) renorming appears to still be open. Survey-style sources note that for RNP spaces, the existence of equivalent LUR, Kadec, and rotund norms is known to be equivalent, but no general construction is known. A positive answer is known in the dual case (every dual space with RNP admits an equivalent LUR norm), but the general non-dual case remains unresolved.

status_evidence.title: Radon-Nikodym Property, Kadec-Klee Norms
status_evidence.snippet: For spaces with the Radon-Nikodym property, the existence of LUR and Kadec equivalent norms are equivalent; whether such norms exist in general RNP spaces is open.
status_evidence.claim: It is still an open problem whether every Banach space with RNP admits an equivalent rotund (or Kadec) norm.

status_evidence.title: Kadec and Krein-Milman properties
status_evidence.snippet: Discussion of Kadec renormings in connection with RNP and related convexity properties.
status_evidence.claim: The RNP-Kadec renorming question is treated as an open problem in the renorming literature.
